Title: Front and back pocket measurements of men's and women's jeans from popular brands

You are given data in the folder `data/`: one or more tables as CSV files, and a one-line title saying what the data is. Read and analyse the data, then make a data report about it: a web page that tells a reader what this data shows.

Deliver two files.

`facts.json`: the findings the page reports, each with the pandas code that computes it from the data.

```json
[{"id": "west-returns-most",
  "claim": "Among regions with at least 100 orders, the West has the highest return rate, 19%, against 14% in the East and 13% in the North.",
  "tables": {"orders": "data/orders.csv"},
  "code": "orders[orders.region.map(orders.region.value_counts()) >= 100].groupby('region').returned.apply(lambda s: (s == 'yes').mean())"}]
```

- `id`: unique in the file, a few meaningful words.
- `claim`: the finding in one sentence, with its numbers.
- `tables`: the files the code reads, each a variable name and the file's path from this folder, such as `data/orders.csv`; every file is read with `pd.read_csv(path)`.
- `code`: one Python expression over those variables, with `pd` (pandas) and `np` (numpy) available, such as `(orders.units > 690).sum()` or `orders.groupby(['region', 'product']).discount.max()`.

How the findings are checked: every `code` is evaluated as written, its value is printed the way pandas prints it, and each claim is compared with that printout and nothing else. A claim that says anything the printout does not show counts as wrong, and one wrong finding scores the whole page 0. So every number, name and comparison in a claim must be readable from the printout of its code, and computed by that code from the tables: code that writes a finding's numbers itself, such as a string or a Series of typed-in values, counts as wrong. Before you finish, evaluate every fact the same way from this folder: read its `tables` with `pd.read_csv`, evaluate its `code`, print the value, and read the printout against the claim.

`index.html`: the page.
- Write all the text on the page in English.
- The page is opened offline. Put all CSS, scripts and data in the file; do not load anything from the network (no CDNs, web fonts, remote images or APIs).
- The page must open and show its content in a desktop browser (1440 px wide) without errors.

How you analyse the data, which tools you use and what the page looks like is up to you.

To see the page, run `pageshot index.html`: it scrolls the page like a reader, saves one screenshot per screen to _shots/frames/ and a shrunk full page to _shots/thumb.jpg; look at them with the read tool. Change the page with the edit tool. Stop once both files are written.

  <script id="raw-data" type="application/json">__DATA__</script>
  <script>
    const raw = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('raw-data').textContent);
    const brandNames = {
      "7 for all mankind": "7 For All Mankind", "abercrombie": "Abercrombie", "american eagle": "American Eagle",
      "arizona": "Arizona", "buckle black": "Buckle Black", "calvin klein": "Calvin Klein", "express": "Express",
      "gap": "Gap", "guess": "Guess", "h&m": "H&M", "j. crew": "J. Crew", "lee": "Lee", "levi's": "Levi’s",
      "lucky": "Lucky", "old navy": "Old Navy", "ralph lauren": "Ralph Lauren", "tommy hilfiger": "Tommy Hilfiger",
      "true religion": "True Religion", "uniqlo": "Uniqlo", "wrangler": "Wrangler"
    };
    const mean = values => values.reduce((a,b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
    const avg2 = (a,b) => (a+b)/2;
    const data = raw.map((d,i) => ({
      ...d, id: i,
      brandKey: d.brand.trim().toLowerCase(),
      brandClean: brandNames[d.brand.trim().toLowerCase()] || d.brand.trim(),
      frontDepth: avg2(d.maxHeightFront,d.minHeightFront),
      frontWidth: avg2(d.maxWidthFront,d.minWidthFront),
      backDepth: avg2(d.maxHeightBack,d.minHeightBack),
      backWidth: avg2(d.maxWidthBack,d.minWidthBack)
    }));
    const genderData = gender => data.filter(d => d.menWomen === gender);
    const genderMean = (gender,key) => mean(genderData(gender).map(d => d[key]));
    const esc = value => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));

    function pocketPath(x,y,w,h,inset=0) {
      x += inset; y += inset; w -= inset*2; h -= inset*2;
      return `M ${x} ${y} L ${x+w} ${y} L ${x+w*.9} ${y+h*.7} Q ${x+w*.78} ${y+h*.96} ${x+w*.5} ${y+h} Q ${x+w*.22} ${y+h*.96} ${x+w*.1} ${y+h*.7} Z`;
    }
    function renderHero() {
      const scale = 10.25, top = 60;
      const specs = [
        {gender:'men', x:70, color:'#28ad9b', label:'MEN', depth:genderMean('men','frontDepth'), width:genderMean('men','frontWidth')},
        {gender:'women', x:310, color:'#f47760', label:'WOMEN', depth:genderMean('women','frontDepth'), width:genderMean('women','frontWidth')}
      ];
      let svg = `<defs><pattern id="denim" width="5" height="5" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(25)"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="white" stroke-opacity=".055" stroke-width="1"/></pattern></defs>`;
      specs.forEach(s => {
        const w=s.width*scale, h=s.depth*scale, y=top;
        svg += `<text x="${s.x}" y="28" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.55)" font-family="Consolas,monospace" font-size="10" letter-spacing="2">${s.label}</text>`;
        svg += `<path d="${pocketPath(s.x,y,w,h)}" fill="${s.color}" fill-opacity=".18" stroke="${s.color}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
        svg += `<path d="${pocketPath(s.x,y,w,h)}" fill="url(#denim)"/>`;
        svg += `<path d="${pocketPath(s.x,y,w,h,8)}" fill="none" stroke="${s.color}" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>`;
        svg += `<path d="M ${s.x-5} ${y} h ${w+10}" stroke="${s.color}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
        const dx=s.x+w+18;
        svg += `<path d="M ${dx} ${y+3} V ${y+h-3} M ${dx-3} ${y+8} l 3-5 3 5 M ${dx-3} ${y+h-8} l 3 5 3-5" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.45)" stroke-width="1"/>`;
        svg += `<text x="${s.x}" y="302" fill="white" font-family="Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="700">${s.depth.toFixed(2)}<tspan font-size="11" font-weight="400"> cm</tspan></text>`;
        svg += `<text x="${s.x}" y="319" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.46)" font-family="Consolas,monospace" font-size="9">${s.width.toFixed(2)} cm wide</text>`;
      });
      svg += `<path d="M 260 55 V 280" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.1)" stroke-dasharray="2 5"/>`;
      document.getElementById('hero-pockets').innerHTML=svg;
    }

    function axisTicks(max,step) {
      let out=''; for(let v=0;v<=max;v+=step) out+=`<span class="axis-tick" style="left:${v/max*100}%">${v}</span>`; return out;
    }
    function renderDimensions() {
      const metrics=[
        {key:'frontDepth',label:'Front depth',sub:'mean of max + min'},
        {key:'frontWidth',label:'Front width',sub:'mean of max + min'},
        {key:'backDepth',label:'Back depth',sub:'mean of max + min'},
        {key:'backWidth',label:'Back width',sub:'mean of max + min'}
      ];
      let html=`<div class="measure-axis"><span></span><div class="axis-track">${axisTicks(25,5)}</div><span></span></div>`;
      metrics.forEach(m=>{
        const men=genderMean('men',m.key), women=genderMean('women',m.key), max=25;
        html+=`<div class="measure-row"><div class="measure-label">${m.label}<small>${m.sub}</small></div><div class="measure-track"><div class="measure-connector" style="left:${women/max*100}%;width:${(men-women)/max*100}%"></div><span class="measure-point women" style="left:${women/max*100}%"><span class="point-value">${women.toFixed(2)}</span></span><span class="measure-point men" style="left:${men/max*100}%"><span class="point-value">${men.toFixed(2)}</span></span></div><div class="measure-gap">+${(men-women).toFixed(2)}<small>cm</small></div></div>`;
      });
      document.getElementById('dimension-chart').innerHTML=html;
      let bars='';
      ['men','women'].forEach(g=>{
        const front=genderMean(g,'frontDepth'),back=genderMean(g,'backDepth'),delta=front-back,color=g==='men'?'var(--men)':'var(--women)';
        bars+=`<div class="within-group"><div class="within-label"><span class="legend-inline"><i class="legend-dot ${g}-dot"></i>${g==='men'?'Men':'Women'}</span><span class="within-delta">${delta>=0?'+':''}${delta.toFixed(2)} cm</span></div>`;
        [['Front',front],['Back',back]].forEach(([label,value])=>{bars+=`<div class="mini-bar-row"><span>${label}</span><div class="mini-bar-track"><div class="mini-bar" style="width:${value/25*100}%;background:${color}"></div></div><span class="mini-bar-value">${value.toFixed(2)}</span></div>`});
        bars+='</div>';
      });
      document.getElementById('within-bars').innerHTML=bars;
    }

    const brandStats=[...new Set(data.map(d=>d.brandKey))].map(key=>{
      const rows=data.filter(d=>d.brandKey===key),men=mean(rows.filter(d=>d.menWomen==='men').map(d=>d.frontDepth)),women=mean(rows.filter(d=>d.menWomen==='women').map(d=>d.frontDepth));
      return {key,name:rows[0].brandClean,men,women,gap:men-women};
    });
    let brandSort='gap';

    renderFit();

  </script>
